# minimalloc

> A learning-oriented C++ concurrent memory pool inspired by Google's tcmalloc. Implements the classic ThreadCache → CentralCache → PageCache three-tier architecture with ~1,500 lines of code.

## Project details

- License: MIT
- Language: C++11+
- Platform: Windows (MSVC)
- Source: https://github.com/ruijayfeng/minimalloc

## Source Code

- [README.md](/README.md) — Overview, architecture diagram, size-class tiers, quick start
- [Common.h](/Common.h) — Core types: FreeList, SizeClass (5-tier alignment), Span, SpanList
- [ThreadCache.cpp](/ThreadCache.cpp) — Per-thread fast-path allocation (TLS)
- [CentralCache.cpp](/CentralCache.cpp) — Bulk transfer between ThreadCache and PageCache
- [PageCache.cpp](/PageCache.cpp) — Span management, page allocation via VirtualAlloc
- [PageMap.h](/PageMap.h) — TCMalloc-style radix tree (1/2/3-level) for page ID mapping

## Tests & Benchmarks

- [UnitTest.cpp](/UnitTest.cpp) — Allocation and deallocation tests
- [BenchMark.cpp](/BenchMark.cpp) — Performance comparison vs new/malloc
